title: tooling(pm): fleet-roster flags 「疑似撞墙」 on every extra seat one account holds in a lane — a `= seat N` row reads only its seat post's updated_at, so an active seat reads as stalled
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Filing gate: **③ a task the maintainer assigned directly.** The maintainer asked in the triage session, verbatim: 「一个人负责车道的四个席位可以增加并发很正常，目前的规则有问题吗？还是车道经理处理的不对」. Triage answered that neither the rule nor the lane was wrong, the roster's measurement was. The maintainer said 「立卡」.
`tooling` queue door: a measured false alarm on the right source, which hides real walls among the false ones (`triage-duties.md`, third door). The instances are named below.
Reader: `domain:devx` (`scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs`; the earlier roster cards #25416 and #25962 were devx's).
Dedupe (open AND closed): `fleet-roster in:title` → 6 hits: #25462 (open, the generated roster), #25962, #28718, #25463, #25416 and one more (closed). None covers activity attribution for a seat that shares its account.
⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens (measured 2026-11-02 ~03:50Z on `main`)

`fleet-roster.mjs`, in the row map (around L364–373):

```js
const first = row.account ? rows.find((r) => r.repo === row.repo && r.lane === row.lane && lc(r.account) === acct) : row;
const sharesWith = first !== row ? first.seat : null;
const inFlight = row.account && sharesWith === null ? cards.filter(...) : [];
const times = [row.updatedAt, ...inFlight.map((c) => c.updatedAt)].filter(Boolean).sort();
```

When one account holds several seats of a lane, every seat but the lowest gets `inFlight = []`. Its `lastActivity` is then the seat post's own `updated_at` alone. Seat posts are rarely edited, because a seat's work lands on cards and PRs. So the row crosses `STALE_HOURS` (6) and reads 「疑似撞墙」 while the seat is working.

**Instances:** `domain:server` seats 2, 3 and 5 (#20966, #26761, #28677), all `os-project-manager`, all rendered `= seat 1` and 「疑似撞墙」 at 2d, 21h and 14h. On the same day each was demonstrably active, as a different session:
- seat 2 (`session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo`) answered #28117 (2026-11-01 19:56Z);
- seat 5 (`session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt`) posted #27855's closure record (19:59Z);
- seat 3 (`session_01FEkQ5kE5BrPUPNMMyv6oCH`) posted seat reviews on #28837, #28838 and #28875;
- all three mailbox PRs (#28284, #28585, #28678) were updated at 03:48–03:50Z.

That is 3 of the 10 flags on that run. The rule allows one account several seats for concurrency (`seat-post-protocol.md`, `project-forms.md` 「一车道多席」), so the false flag is the tool's.

## Wanted

- A seat's last activity reads the seat's own traces. Its seat id and session appear in the signature line of its comments on cards and PRs (claims, seat reviews, closure records), and its mailbox PR has an `updated_at`. The newest of those, the post's `updated_at` and its in-flight cards counts.
- The in-flight column may keep `= seat N`; only the activity reading changes.
- A self-test with one account on two seats of a lane: the second seat is not flagged while its mailbox or a signed comment is fresh, and is flagged when both are older than `STALE_HOURS`.
